reasons.name: Ectopic Pregnancy (Tubal/Extrauterine Implantation)
reasons.clinical_explanation: Embryo implanted outside the uterine cavity (usually Fallopian tube), requiring urgent medical or laparoscopic intervention.

reasons.name: Missed Abortion (Silent Embryonic Arrest)
reasons.clinical_explanation: Fetus stopped developing and cardiac activity ceased without spontaneous uterine expulsion, identified via early transvaginal scan.

reasons.name: D&E / D&C Uterine Evacuation
reasons.clinical_explanation: Dilatation & Curettage or Dilatation & Evacuation performed to safely clear retained non-viable conception products.

reasons.name: Blighted Ovum (Anembryonic Sac)
reasons.clinical_explanation: A gestational sac formed and attached to uterine wall, but the embryonic fetal pole failed to develop due to chromosomal issues.

reasons.name: Spontaneous Miscarriage
reasons.clinical_explanation: Natural early spontaneous pregnancy loss occurring before 12 weeks with bleeding and cramping.

reasons.name: Fetal Cardiac Arrest / Absence
reasons.clinical_explanation: Failure of fetal heart tube formation or cessation of heart beats during first trimester ultrasound assessment.

reasons.name: Fetal Demise / IUD (Intrauterine Fetal Death)
reasons.clinical_explanation: Late-stage fetal death occurring in second or third trimester before or during labor.

reasons.name: Major Congenital / Structural Anomalies
reasons.clinical_explanation: Severe anatomical defects (e.g. anencephaly, severe neural tube defects) detected during 11-13 week NT or 18-20 week anomaly scans.
